title: Crytex platform event envelope
description: Every event on the platform stream. Events are facts about something that already happened; nothing on this stream causes a state change.

id.description: Globally unique, sortable by time. ULID.

type.description: Past tense, always. There is no execute-style event type.

ts.description: When the fact occurred, not when it was published.

user_id.description: Null for events with no user subject, such as market ticks.

trace_id.description: Set when the event was caused by an agent-assisted flow, so an action can be traced back to the conversation that prepared it.

idempotency_key.description: Consumers must treat a repeated key as the same fact. The stream guarantees at-least-once delivery, not exactly-once.

data.description: Type-specific payload. Amounts are decimal strings, never floats. Currency is an explicit ISO or token symbol.

amount.description: Decimal string. Floats are prohibited on this stream because binary rounding on money is not recoverable downstream.

pii.description: Marks a payload containing personal data, so retention and regional routing rules apply to it.
